summary: Independent end-to-end verification of login flow via public preview URL. Login is NOT broken. All three scenarios pass: (1) prefilled manager credentials sign in successfully and redirect to /dashboard, (2) team-member rupali@osagency.in / team123 logs in successfully, (3) wrong password keeps user on /login with a visible red 'Invalid credentials' error. User-reported 'unable to login' is NOT reproducible in a fresh browser context — most likely browser cache / stale localStorage / wrong URL on user's end.

wrong_password.visible_error_text: Invalid credentials (shown in red beneath password field)

action_items: Reply to user: login works end-to-end on the public URL for both manager and team-member accounts. Ask user to (a) try an incognito/private window, (b) clear localStorage for the preview domain, (c) confirm the exact URL they are using, (d) share the exact error message or network tab response they see.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginPage.jsx pre-fills a real password ('manager123') in the password field by default — fine for demo but should be disabled before any production deploy.

'Invalid credentials' error is rendered as a plain

and not inside an element with role='alert' or class containing 'error'/'toast', so some automated error scrapers miss it. Minor — adding role='alert' would improve a11y and testability.
test_credentials: Manager yusuf@osagency.in / manager123 and Team rupali@osagency.in / team123 — both verified working on the public URL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow fully verified end-to-end on https://marketing-ops-suite-4.preview.emergentagent.com against both admin and non-admin seeded accounts. No code changes made.
rca of the issue: User-reported 'unable to login' is NOT reproducible. RCA: likely client-side state on user's browser (stale os_token/os_user in localStorage pointing to a prior preview URL, cached JS bundle, or using a different/older preview URL). Mitigation: user should open the preview URL in a private window, or run `localStorage.clear()` in devtools on the preview origin and reload.
